pr_title: feat(workflow): scaffold core workflowVersion entity + trigger cache (phase 0)

comments.body: `computeForCache` calls `computeAutomatedTriggerFromWorkflowVersion(workflowVersion)` for every ACTIVE version inside one loop with no error handling. For CRON triggers that function calls `computeCronPatternFromSchedule` (`compute-automated-trigger-from-workflow-version.util.ts:314`), which throws `WorkflowTriggerException` for an invalid CUSTOM pattern or an unsupported schedule type (`compute-cron-pattern-from-schedule.ts:10-21,54-61`). Core `triggers` is untyped jsonb, so one ACTIVE version with a bad cron pattern, for example from backfilled data, makes the whole workspace's `workflowAutomatedTriggerMaps` cache fail to compute. Every other workflow's trigger is lost with it. Catch the error per version and skip or log that version instead.
